journey.name: grant signup rejected code
journey.description: Verifies that a signup link whose signup code the homeserver refuses shows a specific message, keeps the authorization sheet open for another try, and creates no identity. Precondition: an isolated unlocked wallet with Paykit enabled and no Pubky identity. A controlled requesting app supplies a signup_grant URL for a reachable homeserver and relay whose signup token that homeserver has already used or does not know, for example the token of a signup_grant URL another wallet already completed. The URL requests ordinary app permissions without a Bitkit companion claim.

actions.action: Copy the prepared signup_grant URL with the refused signup token to the device clipboard
Tap the main wallet Scan button (id "Scan")
If camera permission is requested, deny it to use clipboard input
Tap Authorize (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") and complete PIN or biometric approval when enabled
Verify an error toast says "The homeserver did not accept this signup code. Try again or use another signup link."
Verify the authorization sheet is still open with Authorize (id "PubkyAuthAuthorize") enabled
Verify the Create Profile screen (id "CreateProfileSave") is not shown
Close the authorization sheet and verify the wallet still has no Pubky identity
